caseNameFull: Lauve v. Secretary of State of Michigan Lauve v. Attorney General of Michigan and Lauve v. Secretary of State of Michigan

opinions.text: Appeals from Sup. Ct. Mich, dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeals were taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certio-rari denied. Reported below: 422 Mich. 964 (first case); 424 Mich. 855 (second case); 425 Mich. 874 (third case).
